patches.name: Uncensor patch
patches.notes: Install (PC): Open the Steam game install folder (right click the game in Steam, Properties, Local Files, Browse Local Files...) Enter the folder named 'game' inside the game install folder Download the patch archive from the link below Extract the contents of the downloaded patch archive somewhere onto your PC Copy the two extracted files from the 'Decensor Patch' folder into the 'game' folder opened earlier It's working if: "RESTORATION PATCH DETECTED" should appear in the bottom left hand side of the main menu.
